title: CLEAR: Coupling Local Evidence with Affective Representations for Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation
abstract: arXiv:2605.18547v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In video calls and livestreamed discussions, recognizing speakers' emotions helps identify emotionally salient segments and supports fine-grained video content analysis. Multimodal Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC) provides an approach to recognizing emotions in such content by integrating textual, visual, and acoustic information with conversational context. Current mainstream emotion recognition methods largely leverage the contextual understanding capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict emotions by generating labels. However, emotion understanding and label prediction may be inconsistent, leaving the internal affective information underutilized. Moreover, when the current utterance is jointly modeled with extensive dialogue history and multimodal information, its local discriminative cues may be diluted and become less salient in the resulting contextual representation. translated_title: CLEAR：耦合局部证据与情感表征用于对话中的多模态情感识别
translated_abstract: 在视频通话和直播讨论中，识别说话者的情绪有助于定位情绪显著的片段，并支持细粒度的视频内容分析。对话中的多模态情感识别（ERC）通过将文本、视觉和声学信息与对话上下文相结合，提供了一种识别此类内容中情绪的方法。当前主流的情感识别方法主要利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的上下文理解能力，通过生成标签来预测情绪。然而，情绪理解与标签预测之间可能存在不一致，导致内部情感信息未被充分利用。此外，当当前话语与大量对话历史和多模态信息进行联合建模时，其局部判别性线索可能被稀释，在由此产生的上下文表征中变得不再显著。为解决这些限制……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CLEAR方法，通过将局部判别证据与内部情感表征耦合，解决了多模态大语言模型在对话情感识别中情感理解与标签预测不一致、以及当前话语局部线索被上下文稀释的问题。
